Neck: as you breathe out, lower the chin toward the chest; as you breathe in, lift it back. Several times, slowly.
Tilt the right ear toward the right shoulder and breathe there. Come back to the middle and tilt to the left. The shoulders stay down.
Bring the palms together in front of the chest. Press them lightly, lift the chest and let the shoulders soften.
With an inhale, circle the arms out to the sides and up until the palms meet overhead. With an exhale, lower them through the sides. Repeat with the breath.
Cow-face arms: right arm up, bend the elbow, hand between the shoulder blades. The left hand comes behind the back and reaches up toward it. Hold the fingers or a sleeve. Then change sides.
Lift the shoulders to the ears as you breathe in, let them drop as you breathe out. Then roll them back in slow circles.
Raise both arms overhead, shoulder-width apart, palms facing each other. Reach up through the fingers while the shoulders move away from the ears.
Side bend: right hand on the seat beside you, left arm up and over to the right. Breathe into the left side of the ribs. Come up and change sides.
Eagle arms: arms forward, cross the left arm over the right, bend the elbows and bring the palms toward each other. Lift the elbows a little. Then cross the other way.
Knee to chest: interlace the fingers under the right thigh and draw the knee up, keeping the back tall. Then the left knee.
Hip stretch: place the right ankle on the left knee, rest the right hand just above the right knee and lean forward a little with a long back. Then the other leg.
Twist: turn to the right, one hand on the back of the chair, the other on the knee. Grow taller as you breathe in, turn a little more as you breathe out. Back to the middle, then to the left.
Forward bend: feet a little wider, fold over the thighs and let the arms and head hang. Come up slowly, the head last.
Rest: fold your arms on a table or on your thighs, lay your forehead on them and breathe quietly for a minute or longer.
